description: Player profile panel + enter/exit animation. Clicking a fingerprint in the small-multiples grid opens that player's profile: the clicked fingerprint scales up / moves to an anchor while the others fade/recede and stats fade in. Profile content (all in the player's PLAYER_COLORS color, matching mocks/scrolly-profile.png): header (name + 'FIRST DATE · 2025-26 SEASON' + '✕ close'), headline stat row from players.json, a large labelled Fingerprint, three horizontal-bar slot breakdowns sharing one max across the three *.summary.json files, and a labelled season-arc strip. Close via ✕ button / Escape / click-away reverses back to the small-multiples grid. Depends on FEAT-002 (phase machine + grid) and FEAT-001 (Fingerprint).
steps: Create src/PlayerProfile.jsx + src/PlayerProfile.css. Component PlayerProfile({ name, onClose }). Mount it when phase==='profile' (SeasonStory passes profilePlayer). Use the player's color = PLAYER_COLORS[name] throughout.

Header: player name large in the player color (serif bold), kicker 'FIRST DATE · 2025-26 SEASON' in INK_TOKENS.muted, and a '✕ close' affordance (button) top-right calling onClose. Panel styling mirrors the mock (dark panel #15162b with a player-color border at low opacity, rounded).

Headline stat row from players.json (PLAYER_STATS[name]): shows=showsAppeared, initiations=totalInitiations, walk-ons=totalWalkons, full joins=totalFullJoins, hosts=hosts, words=gets. Number-over-label, big number in INK ink, label in muted uppercase (like the mandala center and the mock).
Large participation fingerprint: reuse <Fingerprint name R={larger, e.g. 150} labels/> with slot labels, matching the mock's scaled-up fingerprint.

Three scene-slot breakdowns as horizontal bars over slots ['1A','1B','1C','D','2A','2B','2C','E','3s'] from initiations.summary.json, walkons.summary.json, fulljoins.summary.json (each an array of { player, '1A'.. }). Look up the row by player. Compute ONE shared max across all three breakdowns so bar lengths are comparable (mirror the mock's maxAll). Bars in the player color, value + slot labels per the mock. Label the three groups INITIATIONS / WALK-ONS / FULL JOINS.

Season-arc strip: shows.json sorted by showIndex ascending with null showIndex last; render 25 cells in that order; filled cell (player color, high opacity) if (show.roster||[]).includes(name), faint cell (#2a2b44, low opacity) otherwise. Add the label 'SEASON ARC (shows appeared)' in muted.

Enter animation: on opening, the clicked grid fingerprint scales up / moves to the profile anchor while the other 10 fingerprints fade/recede; profile stats/breakdowns fade in around it. Use CSS transitions driven by the phase change (consistent with FEAT-002's approach). Respect prefers-reduced-motion (snap).

Exit: onClose (triggered by the ✕ button, the Escape key via a keydown listener, or a click-away on the backdrop) sets phase back to 'smallMultiples' and reverses the animation so the fingerprint returns to its grid cell and the others fade back in. Clean up the keydown listener on unmount.
acceptance_criteria: In `npm run dev`, clicking a fingerprint opens that player's profile with the enter animation (clicked fingerprint scales/moves to anchor, others recede, stats fade in); the layout matches mocks/scrolly-profile.png.

Headline stats match players.json for the player; the three slot-bar breakdowns use data from the three *.summary.json files and share one max for comparable lengths; the season-arc strip fills exactly the shows whose roster includes the player.
Closing via the ✕ button, the Escape key, or a click-away reverses the animation and returns to the small-multiples grid.
With prefers-reduced-motion set, open/close snap instead of animating. Scrolling back up to the mandala still works and Export poster still works.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm exit code 0.

Run `npm run dev`: open profiles for a few players (e.g. Brendan to match the mock), verify stats/fingerprint/bars/season-arc against mocks/scrolly-profile.png, and verify close via button, Escape, and click-away each return to the grid.
Confirm reduced-motion snaps and that FEAT-002 scroll morph + Mandala export still work (no regression).

=== NEW FILES ===
src/PlayerProfile.jsx — PlayerProfile({ name, onClose }). Rendered by SeasonStory when phase==='profile' (placeholder removed; now `<PlayerProfile name={profilePlayer} onClose={closeProfile}/>`). Everything player-specific uses PLAYER_COLORS[name] via a CSS custom prop `--player-color` on .profile-panel (border) and inline on the name text + bar fills + arc cells. Structure mirrors mocks/gen-scrolly.mjs mockProfile():
  - Header: h2 name (player color, SERIF bold) + kicker 'FIRST DATE · 2025–26 SEASON' (muted) + a '✕ close' <button> top-right calling onClose.
  - Headline stat row from players.json via PLAYER_STATS = Object.fromEntries(players.map(p=>[p.name,p])) (same pattern as Mandala.jsx): shows=showsAppeared, initiations=totalInitiations, walk-ons=totalWalkons, full joins=totalFullJoins, hosts=hosts, words=gets. Number-over-label: big number INK ink, label muted uppercase.
  - Large fingerprint: <Fingerprint name R={150} labels/> (no showName — the name is already in the header, matching the mock which has no name-under-fingerprint).
  - Three slot breakdowns (INITIATIONS / WALK-ONS / FULL JOINS) as horizontal bars over SLOTS=['1A','1B','1C','D','2A','2B','2C','E','3s'] from initiations/walkons/fulljoins.summary.json. slotRow(sum,name) looks up the row by player and returns [slot,value] in canonical SLOTS order (missing => 0). ONE shared max: maxAll = Math.max(1, ...all three rows' values) — mirrors the mock's maxAll (the Math.max(1,…) floor just guards divide-by-zero; real data max is well above 1). Bar width = value/maxAll*100%. Slot label uses SLOT_LABEL (D/E->'GG', 3s->'3rd'); value shown at row end.
  - Season-arc strip: shows.json sorted by (showIndex ?? 999) ascending (null last), 25 cells; filled (player color, opacity .95) if (show.roster||[]).includes(name), faint (#2a2b44, opacity .6) otherwise. Label 'SEASON ARC (shows appeared)' (muted). Each cell has title={show.showTitle}.
  - Close wired THREE ways, all -> onClose: the ✕ button, Escape (window keydown listener in a useEffect, cleaned up on unmount), and click-away on the .profile-backdrop (panel calls stopPropagation so inner clicks don't close). SeasonStory.closeProfile() sets phase back to 'smallMultiples', so morphActive stays true and the grid/center-fade state is preserved behind/after the dialog.
  - Imports data as ES modules (Vite-resolved) exactly like the rest of src: players/shows/initiations.summary/walkons.summary/fulljoins.summary .json, plus SLOTS+SLOT_LABEL from ./fingerprintGeometry and PLAYER_COLORS/INK_TOKENS/SERIF from ./palette.
src/PlayerProfile.css — dark panel #15162b, border in var(--player-color), rounded 14px, fixed backdrop rgba(15,16,32,.78). ENTER animation is CSS keyframes (consistent with FEAT-002's phase-class approach): .profile-backdrop fades in (profile-backdrop-in 320ms), .profile-panel fades+scales in (profile-panel-in 420ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1): scale .94 + translateY 14px -> none) — reads as the clicked fingerprint's profile growing in toward its anchor while the backdrop dims the receding grid. Bar fills animate width 420ms. EXIT is React unmount (phase flips to smallMultiples and the whole dialog unmounts, revealing the grid again). prefers-reduced-motion:reduce zeroes the panel/backdrop animations and the bar transition (snap).
